title: 7S.3 DWG GROUP dictionary registration and emission indexes
scope: Generated fast implementation slice removing repeated GROUP dictionary registration/emission scans while preserving authoritative order and rollback semantics.
changes: Added lazily derived pending NOD/GROUP name and handle indexes plus emitted GROUP dictionary/frame membership indexes.
Invalidated derived caches on compound rollback and rebuilt them from authoritative vectors.
Reserved the emitted GROUP frame vector once after registration callbacks instead of issuing repeated exact-size reserves per entry.
Extended the existing generated GROUP dictionary control with 128 groups and exact dictionary/callback order, names, handles, owners, and member links across six DWG output versions.
